summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K to disclose a major shareholder announcement: Orbis Investment Management Limited reported holdings of 3,112,476 shares (4.99% of capital and voting rights) as of June 12, 2026, under Section 30 of the Danish Capital Markets Act. The filing is a regulatory disclosure of a passive threshold crossing, not an activist campaign or takeover event. No deal terms, board recommendation, or strategic action are involved. As a passive holding notification, it triggers no special-situation classification; the event is routine regulatory compliance.
